format: leaf = list of triples (pivot i, free block j, third k) for every orbit whose pivot is not A; the orbit (i,j,k) belongs to pair {i,j} and its D-partner is the orbit (i,k,j); a pair whose two orbits have different pivots is twisted; A = the degree-6 block (all its pairs anchored at A), whose D-structure is FREE (130 options: 6-cycles, 3+3, 4+2, 2+2+2); the pair-level phi is NOT fixed by a leaf.
